scripts.check: pnpm ork once --as check --covers check:changed -- pnpm run check:all
scripts.check:all: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run map:check && pnpm run benchmarks:check
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run docs:check
scripts.check:static: pnpm run check:fast && pnpm run map:check && pnpm run benchmarks:check
scripts.check:changed: pnpm ork once --as check:changed --with-head -- pnpm run check:changed:run
scripts.check:changed:run: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && vitest run --changed --passWithNoTests && pnpm run docs:check && pnpm run map:check && pnpm run benchmarks:check
scripts.release: pnpm run build && changeset publish && node tools/release/latest-tag.ts
